failure_and_consequence_review.risk: A compact finding can itself omit the decisive source detail.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Retain originals and source linkage, keep unfinished questions visible internally, and let analyst/reviewer reopen sources. No compulsory summary chain or assertion that a shorter input proves quality.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: A shared research error could spread across consumers or persist in cache.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Version the existing research artifact and its inputs; preserve correction history and evidence dates. A substantive correction updates the shared result used by consumers. Run-artifact updates do not grant wiki or user-data write permission.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: A dominant early theme or a large already-paid investigation crowds out another important development.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Question selection precedes the integrated narrative; publication assesses the whole current agenda independently of cost already spent. Explicit selection can cover a development in the overview or a grouped story without requiring one card for every source.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: Named-source navigation adds reads or the model chooses poor sources.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Keep useful existing findings and full relevant passages in working context; readers provide access to additional originals. Model-call count and latency must be measured in the complete comparison. Reuse the existing loop instead of adding orchestration.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: More parallel research consumes closing funds or prevents timely publication.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Protect core credit first, admit bounded concurrent work against one ledger, and stop discretionary admissions with enough time for the existing completion/persistence reserve. Retries retain the original clock. Preserve finished current results and operationally report failed work.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: Budget flexibility becomes hidden overspending or unnecessary work.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Record why each extra question is useful, its admitted obligation, actual/unknown charge and remaining allowance. The50%margin is configurable capacity, not an automatic increase or minimum spend.

failure_and_consequence_review.risk: A failed core model call is disguised as a fresh report.
failure_and_consequence_review.response: Never re-date an old narrative. Use existing bounded retry and current-run completed artifacts; keep a real inference/publication failure explicit if no valid current result exists.

acceptance.quality: Complete visible feed explains the consequential business and economic developments, retains important distinctions and useful indirect hypotheses, uses original event dates, selects quantities judiciously and keeps process commentary internal. No required wording or ticker list.
acceptance.generalization: Owner examples remain diagnostic cases; include different companies, event types and quiet/heavy conditions. Personally inspect source-to-finding-to-publication handoffs. Semantic review or passing software checks alone is not acceptance.
acceptance.reliability: Partial acquisition/review trouble preserves independent completed findings. Deadline/retry/settlement failures do not reset allowance, erase useful paid work, publish an old story as new or hide an actual provider outage.
acceptance.cost: Measure complete attempt-inclusive usage, cache behavior, latency, current credit and unknown bounds. No cost-reduction or quality guarantee before the full comparison.
